## Activity

During October 2023, Central Eye Clinic recorded 193 captures. This represents the site’s reported activity for the month. The capture total provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading outcomes. No further activity information is recorded in this report.

## Image quality

Of the 193 captures, 1 was ungradable. The ungradable rate was 0.5. This indicates that nearly all images submitted during October 2023 were suitable for grading. Staff raised no new equipment faults this month.

## Grading

There were 45 referable results among the captures reviewed. The median grading lag was 1. The grading results and the image-quality findings should be considered together when monitoring the site’s operational performance. The report records the activity, ungradable images, referable results, and grading lag for Central Eye Clinic during October 2023.
